output.summary: A herbaceous perennial endemic to New Zealand, naturally occurring near the sea on rocks north of Greymouth and Kaikōura. Its tall flower stalk bears many white flowers with purple, white and yellow stamens. Māori historically ate its rhizomes after cooking them in a hāngī.
output.edibilityNote: Rhizomes are edible when cooked and were historically cooked in a hāngī and eaten by Māori.
